questions.text: Explain the basic structure of a FORTRAN program. What are the fundamental data types in FORTRAN? Write a FORTRAN program to read and sort 10 integers entered by the user in ascending order.
Write a program in C to check whether a number entered by the user is prime or composite. Also draw a flowchart for the algorithm.
Define pointer. List down the importance of pointer in C programming. Describe the relationship between 1D array and pointer with a suitable code example.
Write a program in C to display the nth term of a Fibonacci sequence using a recursive function. The value of n is entered by the user.

How is a binary file different from a text file? Write the syntax and use of fseek() and rewind() functions in C. Write a C program to write records of N students (Name, Roll, Marks) into a data file and display students scoring above 40.
What do you mean by 'call by value and call by reference'? Explain the differences with suitable examples and memory diagrams.
Define 1D and 2D arrays. Write a program in C to read an m x n matrix from the user, pass it to a user-defined function, and calculate and display the transpose of the matrix.
Explain in brief the steps involved during the compilation process in C along with a suitable block diagram showing the roles of the preprocessor, compiler, assembler, and linker.

Write a program to define a structure named 'person' with members Name, Address, Salary, and Phone Number. Input details of 100 persons and display the entered information in descending order of salary.
Compare nested if with else if ladder structure along with their flowcharts. Write a program to determine the largest among three numbers using nested if-else.
What is a structure? Why is it necessary? Write a program to add two distances given in feet and inches using a user-defined structure.

Write a program to check whether a given N-digit positive integer is an Armstrong number or not. (Hint: A number equal to the sum of its own digits each raised to the power of the number of digits, e.g. 1634 = 1^4 + 6^4 + 3^4 + 4^4).
Write a program in C to reverse a string without using any string handling library function (e.g. strrev()). Also explain how to find the length of a string without using strlen().
Write a program in FORTRAN to read a positive integer from the user and check whether it is a prime number or not using a DO loop and IF condition.
Define precedence and associativity of operators with examples. Differentiate between formatted and unformatted input/output functions (printf/scanf vs gets/puts/getchar/putchar) in C.
Write a program to calculate the factorial of an integer entered by the user using the concept of a recursive function. Explain how memory is allocated on the call stack during recursive execution.
